errors.evidence: The description of the horizontal axis categories omits the final category, "S₅-model".
The y-axis does not have a labeled range. Based on the data points, the visible range is approximately 84.5 to 89.5. The stated range of 85 to 91 is incorrect.

errors.text_span: with tick labels at increments of 1
errors.evidence: The visible tick labels are 86 and 88, which indicates an increment of 2, not 1.

errors.text_span: the blue bar has an approximate height of 84, while the orange bar reaches approximately 86
errors.evidence: For the "Prefix" method, the blue bar is at approximately 84.8 and the orange bar is at approximately 85.8 (below the 86 tick mark).
For the "Adaptor" method, the blue bar is at approximately 84.8 (not 83) and the orange bar is at approximately 88.1 (not 85).

errors.text_span: approximately 85 and 87 in blue and orange respectively
errors.evidence: For the "LoRA" method, the blue bar is at approximately 86.8 (not 85) and the orange bar is at approximately 89.2 (not 87).

errors.text_span: approximate heights of 86 and 88 for blue and orange bars respectively
errors.evidence: For the "BitFit" method, the blue bar is at approximately 84.8 (not 86) and the orange bar is at approximately 87.7 (just under 88).
For the "S₁-model", both the blue and orange bars are at the same approximate height of 85.6, not 82 and 88.
For the "S₄-model", the blue bar is at approximately 86.2 (not 87) and the orange bar is at approximately 87.6 (not 90).
For the "S₅-model", the blue bar is at approximately 87.1 (not 89) and the orange bar is at approximately 89.4 (not 91). No bar in the chart reaches 90 or above.
The description does not state that the y-axis does not start at zero, which is an important feature of the scale presentation.
